resale_co.notes: The Community Development and Planning page lists about 40 construction and zoning forms but no resale CO, continued occupancy or housing resale inspection form; the only 'Certificate of Occupancy' form is the state UCC F270 construction CO for permitted work. The township code (ecode360 GL0340) could not be opened. The township did not state that no resale CO is needed, so status is not found. The lead URL in leads.json points to Gloucester City, not Gloucester Township.

requirements: Districts 1, 2, 4 and 5: CO alarms must be less than 7 years old
Districts 1, 4 and 5: smoke alarms older than 10 years not accepted; battery alarms must be 10-year sealed (hardwired exempt); hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Basement smoke alarm at the bottom of the stairwell on the ceiling (not between joists); hallway alarms within 10 feet of all bedroom doors
House numbers at least 4 inches high, contrasting color, permanently on the house and visible from the street (mailbox or light post numbers not accepted)

Homes with a secondary power source (solar, generator, battery storage) need a non-handwritten 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER' label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and the electric meter
District 5 checklist: alarm type follows the year the house was built (for example 1991 to present: hardwired interconnected alarms with battery backup on every level and in each bedroom)
Current 2025-2026 district forms do not list a fire extinguisher (District 6's 2026 affidavit title still says 'Portable Fire Extinguisher' but its checklist has no extinguisher item)

authorities.how_to_apply: For a sale, the owner or agent completes and signs the district's CSACMAPFEC affidavit (self-certification in lieu of inspection under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3(b)) and emails it to Inspections@gtfd6.com or drops it off at 1946 Williamstown-Erial Road, Sicklerville (mailbox if no one is there). Pay by cash or check payable to GTFD6; no certificate until paid. Affidavits are processed once a week. Rentals with a new tenant are inspected in person. Certificate valid 6 months, not transferable.

fire_cert.notes: Gloucester Township has six fire districts, and the right one depends on the address: look up the property on the township's Edmunds page (https://wipp.edmundsassoc.com/Wipp/?wippid=0415); the fire district appears in the 'Special Taxing Districts' block. District 3 (Blenheim) has no local fire code enforcing agency; the NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety issues smoke certificates there (DCA registry code 'S', and DCA's state-enforced towns list marks it 'SC = Smoke Certs'). Fees differ by district: Districts 2 and 6 charge $35/$70/$125; Districts 1, 4 and 5 and DCA charge $45/$90/$161. The township website also hosts an outdated District 1 form from 2014 (https://glotwp.com/downloads/General/District1.pdf, $35/$70/$125 with an extinguisher requirement); District 1's own current form is dated 08-2025. District 5's form is an undated scan. The DCA fire directory lists District 5 fire official email sschwegel@lambsfire.com; not added as the district's own site does not show it.
